section_meta.section_name: Our Impact / Where the Dignity Doll Has Reached
section_meta.context: Nonprofit menstrual-dignity microsite in India. Editorial visual highlight section set within existing React + Tailwind + Framer Motion + Lenis stack.
section_meta.theme_transition: Deliberate warm shift: from the site's default light-pink (#FBECF2) base to a rich editorial warm ivory/cream background (#FAF6F0) with deep burgundy/maroon (#6A1B29), Rutuja blue (#295EAA), muted gold (#C5A059), and restrained pink (#C82B62) accents.

emotional_storytelling_and_archetype.archetype: Editorial Social-Impact & Indian Craft Heritage (Fusion of Warm Organic + Swiss Narrative Clarity)
emotional_storytelling_and_archetype.tone: Human, premium, culturally grounded, credible, deeply respectful, warm.
emotional_storytelling_and_archetype.narrative_arc: Moves from an intimate conversation starter to a nationwide grassroots ripple effect. The visual story proves that dignity is not just a geographic pin—it is a documented moment where silence was transformed into honest dialogue.
anti_patterns_avoided: No generic Google Maps style, blue pins, or road tiles.
No cartoonish bouncing pins, spinning 3D globes, or scroll-jacking.
No generic corporate charity gloss, heavy glassmorphism, or neon gradients.
No overcrowded equal-grid cards; layout uses asymmetric tension and editorial whitespace.
No full-screen gradients; uses tactile warm paper feel with subtle Indian block-print woodcut linework.

journey_lines.description: Curved SVG Bezier paths radiating smoothly from the Mumbai/Thane outreach hub to the other 5 documented state clusters (Delhi, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Odisha, Karnataka).

marker_pins.context: Community sessions held in Delhi — at V.P. Singh Camp and Lal Kuan, introducing the doll to diverse urban settlements.

Sessions at the Lakshit Career Institute and a local skilling centre — where an adolescent girl who had long stayed silent finally shared her first-period experience, giving others the courage to speak.

venues: Rani Lakshmi Bai Silai Prashikshan Kendra
marker_pins.context: Sessions at the Rani Lakshmi Bai Silai Prashikshan Kendra and Swami Vivekanand Bal Sansthan — where a participant understood, for the first time, that menstruation is natural and not a taboo.
The primary outreach hub in Maharashtra — facilitating statewide training, community workshops at Lodha Amara, and ambassador coordination.
Higher education and grassroots school programmes across Bhubaneswar and Balasore, engaging students and faculty in period dignity dialogues.
Tailoring training units and schools in Bengaluru, where women shared: 'Holding the Dignity Doll made me feel like I was comforting my younger self.'

marker_pin_visual_spec.type: Multi-layer Refined Glow/Pulse Beacon (NOT a generic bouncing pin)
layers: 1. Ambient Aura: SVG circle r=18 with animate opacity [0.4, 0] and scale [0.8, 1.8], fill=#6A1B29/20, duration 2.4s ease-out.
2. Outer Solid Stroke Ring: SVG circle r=10, fill=#FFFFFF, stroke=#C5A059, strokeWidth=1.5, dropShadow=[0 2px 8px rgba(106,27,41,0.18)].
3. Core Jewel: SVG circle r=6.5, fill=#6A1B29 (Burgundy) or #295EAA (Rutuja Blue for Hub), with active state expanding to r=8.
4. Center Gold Pip: SVG circle r=2.2, fill=#C5A059 (Muted Gold) on white center.
5. Floating Label: Small serif badge next to marker on desktop with location name, background #FCF9F5, border #E4DAD0, text-xs text-editorial-ink.

step_by_step_execution: Step 1: Update /app/frontend/src/data/content.js with rich bilingual copy for the new headline ('From one conversation to communities across India.'), eyebrow ('WHERE THE CONVERSATION IS HAPPENING'), supporting text, National Pilot numbers, and closing statement.
Step 2: Update /app/frontend/src/data/impactMap.js to export enhanced pin structures with rich location metadata, venue chips, photo mapping, and journey bezier anchors.

Step 3: Refactor /app/frontend/src/components/sections/ImpactMap.jsx into the premium editorial section featuring: warm ivory container (#FAF6F0), custom block-print SVG ornaments, hand-built India SVG map with smooth pulse markers and gold journey lines, interactive side story panel with photo support, National Pilot By the Numbers count-up strip, and closing quote banner.
Step 4: Ensure all data-testid attributes are cleanly bound for testing agent and verify responsive layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_purity: Avoid generic AI centered blocks or plain SaaS cards. Treat this section like a feature spread in a high-end cultural magazine (Architectural Digest / Monocle meets Grassroots India).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Do not flood the section with bright neon pink or corporate blue. Anchor in warm ivory (#FAF6F0) and deep burgundy (#6A1B29), using Rutuja Blue and Pink only as intentional accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion_subtlety: Ensure all animations feel weighty and measured (~600-900ms). Never use snappy bounce effects. Always respect prefers-reduced-motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_stability: Every button, pin, venue chip, metric, and text block must have its exact data-testid matching this guideline.
